title: Northrim BanCorp, Inc. Announces Board Chair Change; Huston to Succeed Schierhorn as Chairman of the Board
summary: ANCHORAGE, Alaska, Aug. 22, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - At yesterday’s board of directors (“Board”) meeting, Joe Schierhorn announced his retirement from Northrim BanCorp, Inc. (Nasdaq:NRIM) (“Northrim” or the “Company”) effective as of December 31, 2025. As part of its continuing succession plan, the Board announced that Mike Huston, current President CEO, will succeed Mr. Schierhorn as Chairman of the Board of Northrim Bank (the “Bank”) and Company on January 1, 2026, in addition to his current responsibilities. Mr. Huston has been with the Company since 2017 serving as President since 2022 and President and CEO since 2024. "It has been an honor to be part of the Bank since its inception. We have invested in Alaska, connected with our community and created a culture of customer first service and I know the organization will continue to do so going forward," said Schierhorn.
